title: Your fall weekend by the river

voice.instructions: Read the supplied script verbatim, in a friendly conversational brand voice telling a listener about a useful camping app. Warm, casual, lightly enthusiastic, confident and unhurried. Deliver the opening directly, then explain the reservation scope immediately. The reservation sentence is a helpful heads-up, not an alarm. Give gentle emphasis to campsites, your dates, and same app. Use natural contractions as written, brief breaths between ideas, and a relaxed final sentence. Eddy sounds like Eddie; Current is the river name; Jacks Fork is two words; Recreation.gov is recreation dot gov. No announcer voice, exaggerated accent, whispering, fake testimonial, additional words, or rushed ending. No music or sound effects.

scenes.text: You can't just show up and camp on the Current anymore.
scenes.visual: Authentic Current River footage with hook AND readable scope label visible from the first frame, held through the next sentence. The scope label must never be cropped or reduced to fine print.
scenes.onScreenText: You can't just show up and camp on the Current anymore.
scenes.scopeLabel: Ozark National Scenic Riverways • Developed campgrounds

scenes.text: At developed campgrounds in Ozark National Scenic Riverways, you need a reservation.
scenes.visual: Continue river/campground footage. Caption the full claim; small context label: Ozark National Scenic Riverways • Developed campgrounds.

scenes.text: Eddy helps you put the weekend together. You can browse campgrounds by river, check photos, and see which campsites have openings for your dates.
scenes.visual: Real iPhone capture: camping grouped by river, open campground, browse photos, show individual site availability. Cut across these actions within this passage.

scenes.text: There’s a calendar view, too, so if your weekend’s flexible, you can look ahead.
scenes.visual: Slow horizontal scroll through the availability calendar. Keep dates and availability legend legible.

scenes.text: And you can check river levels and the weather in the same app, so you’ve got a better idea of what to expect before you leave.
scenes.visual: Show the relevant river's gauge/condition and reading timestamp, then the weather. Do not imply a gauge certifies campsite safety.

scenes.text: Once you find your spot, Eddy takes you to Recreation.gov to book.
scenes.visual: Tap Book campsite for the same supported NPS campground; hold on the matching Recreation.gov destination before checkout.

scenes.text: Find your campsite in Eddy—link in bio.
scenes.visual: Return to the opening river shot with Eddy and Link in bio. Verify the profile link reaches the app landing page before publication. Loop the scenery without obscuring the completed booking handoff.
